syntax:&.d: Elementwise and of boolean masks (put each comparison in parentheses).

syntax:@.d: Matrix multiplication (torch.matmul); batched over leading dimensions.

syntax:arith.d: Arithmetic works elementwise; when shapes differ they broadcast: axes of length 1 (or missing on the left) stretch to match.

syntax:class.d: Define a model: subclass nn.Module, create the layers in __init__ (after super().__init__()), compute the output in forward(x).

syntax:ellipsis.d: ... stands for all the remaining axes: x[..., 0] indexes the last axis.

syntax:fancy.d: Index with a list of positions: picks those elements, in that order.

syntax:index.d: Index: x[0] is the first element, x[-1] the last; on a 2-D x it is a row.

syntax:lambda.d: A small anonymous function, e.g. for LambdaLR or a sort key.

syntax:len.d: The size of the first dimension (for a Dataset: how many samples it has).

syntax:mask.d: Boolean mask: keep the elements where the condition is True (combine conditions with & and |, each in parentheses).

syntax:multi-index.d: Index several axes at once: x[1, 2] is row 1, column 2; x[:, 0] is the first column.

syntax:newaxis.d: None inserts a new axis of length 1, e.g. to turn a row into a column so it broadcasts.

syntax:setitem.d: Assign into x: writes into the existing data (and into every view that shares it).

syntax:slice.d: Slice: from start up to, not including, stop; leave a side out to go from the beginning or to the end. A slice is a view, not a copy.

syntax:slice-step.d: Slice with a step: x[::2] takes every other element, x[::-1] reverses.

syntax:with.d: A context manager: no-grad, autocast or profiling applies only inside the block.

syntax:~.d: Elementwise not: flips a boolean mask.
